author: Caleb Okes
title: Lawyer tragically passes away after medical episode in Mercer County Courthouse - NewsBreak
text:
By Caleb Okes ,
3 hours ago
PRINCETON, WV (WVNS) – The Princeton community lost well-respected lawyer Earl Hager after an emergency medical episode took place in the Mercer County courthouse on Tuesday, September 16, 2025.
Gov. Morrisey aims to transform healthcare outcomes in West Virginia Hager was at the courthouse on the second floor when this episode took place.
The specific medical issue and some other key details remain unconfirmed, but Mercer County Commissioner Bill Archer said there was a collapse. First responders and law enforcement responded quickly to get Hager out of the building and to WVU Medicine Princeton Community Hospital. Hager was due for additional tests when he passed away.
Archer took time to reflect on his experiences with Hager.
“I had some problems with my knees and hip. And so therefore I ride the elevator, and we were often on the same schedule and, you know, it was just a really good person. And to me and also a good lawyer who is very dedicated to his craft and to the work that he did,” said Archer.
Archer explained that Hager had some mobility challenges which forced him to ride the elevator when he went to the courthouse. Archer applauded the first responders and the law enforcement who were able to get Hager to the hospital in such a scary time.
Beloved judge in Tazewell County passes away “Everyone in the courthouse had a relationship [with Hager]. He was just such a friendly, outgoing person. [It is] just just really sad time. I was saddened to learn of what took place. But I was happy that I got to know him and and that I considered him a friend,” said Archer.
